sloka: तौ भासयन्तावाकाशं धनुर्भ्यां विशिखौ च्युतौ।मुखेन मुखमाहत्य सन्निपेततुरोजसा ।। ६.९१.५१ ।।
transliteration: tau bhāsayantāvākāśaṁ dhanurbhyāṁ viśikhau cyutau।mukhena mukhamāhatya sannipetaturojasā ।। 6.91.51 ।।

translations.english: The two best bows of both the heroes together, being powerful, shone with splendour when drawn with bowstring.
